description: Capabilities for the AccessibleAudioStudio Pro main window. Most of the app calls no Tauri commands at all — microphone access, recording, playback, and storage are all standard web APIs (getUserMedia, MediaRecorder, IndexedDB) handled by the WebView2 runtime, not Tauri IPC. Open Audio is the exception: it uses the dialog plugin's native file picker and the fs plugin's read_file command (see app/js/audioEditorController.js) instead of an HTML file input, for reliable multi-file selection. dialog:allow-open's own scope-injection covers exactly the paths the user picks there, so fs:allow-read-file needs no separate static path scope here.
